name: Magic: The Gathering
tagline: Create a private singles listing draft, explore Commander catalogue previews, and find the NZ Magic community. Automatic listings and payments are not yet live.

clone.rule: Clone shell + capability bindings. Never copy inventory. Never invent templates outside factory.
steps: Set slug, name, short, accent, routes, catalog path
Create empty catalog public/data/{slug}-catalog.json with products: []
Point public/{slug}/index.html at silo-master.css + new manifest path
Cube compile_candidate then gauntlet_check then publish_approval_gate
Activate only with verified supply atom and buyer path

accept_when: catalog empty or every product has verified supply fields
list path works without cross-silo data
no revenue claim without settled payment evidence
public copy has no internal control-plane language

community_blocks.title: Prepare a clear listing
community_blocks.body: Choose the exact card and printing, condition, NZD price and your region. The draft remains on this device until you choose to share it.

community_blocks.title: Explore deck previews
community_blocks.body: See catalogue and decklist details. All physical stock and shipping must be independently confirmed before any payment.

community_blocks.title: Talk Magic
community_blocks.body: Join existing Happy Homarid community conversations through Patreon. The on-site forum and peer marketplace are not yet active.
